title: [review] provisioning.py:451: Existing session overwritten w
description: create_br_session() overwrites any existing session for the same peer_host without calling _remove_session(wipe=True) on the old session. This leaks cryptographic state and could leave session keys in memory.
close_reason: Fixed: Added _remove_session(wipe=True) before overwriting existing sessions in create_br_session() and create_node_session(). Added tests to verify cryptographic state is wiped when sessions are replaced.
